posts.author: Not-Red
posts.body:
Hi, I'm making a battle system where reaching 100 TP knocks you out, is there a plugin that changes the colour of the gauge's text (like low HP) and/or displays a message when TP gets too high?
Thanks.

posts.author: JohnDoeGames
posts.body:
I don't know about the text color changing, but you could run a troop event (in the troop page) that checks each turn if TP is over 85, and if so, make the screen flash and/or play a sound effect.
If you use yanfly YEP_BaseTroopEvent (hope I remember the plugins name right), you only have to do this in 1 troop, once for each party member (so four times if your party can't have more than 4 members) and it will be copied over into all other troops.
